title: Right Diagnoses, Decorative Reasoning:A Perturbation Audit of Medical Chain-of-Thought
abstract: arXiv:2608.24790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinicians read chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales as evidence of medical reasoning, but whether the visible chain plays that role is rarely tested. General-domain CoT-faithfulness probes ignore clinical cost, and medical LLM evaluations treat the chain as a black box. We close this gap with a medical perturbation audit: a 30-operator battery edits both the chain and the question with clinically motivated operators (severity reversal, negation flip, demographic swap, evidence ablation), paired with a chain-update times answer-flip joint analysis that classifies each model by its failure mode. Applied to 14 LLMs on four medical QA benchmarks, three independent tests converge: the Chain-Decoupling Rate (CDR; chain does not register the edit and the answer does not flip) is 72.9% panel-wide on clinically meaningful destructive edits, chain corruption leaves accuracy unchanged, and removing CoT prompting does not reduce accuracy. translated_title: 正确诊断，装饰性推理：医学思维链的扰动审计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24790v1 公告类型：新 摘要：临床医生将思维链（CoT）理由视为医学推理的证据，但可见的思维链是否真正发挥这一作用却很少被测试。通用领域的CoT忠实性探针忽略了临床成本，而医学大语言模型评估则将思维链视为黑箱。我们通过医学扰动审计填补了这一空白：一个包含30个操作符的测试集，使用临床动机操作符（严重性反转、否定翻转、人口统计交换、证据消融）编辑思维链和问题，并结合思维链更新与答案翻转的联合分析，按失败模式对每个模型进行分类。应用于四个医学问答基准上的14个大语言模型，三个独立测试结果一致：思维链解耦率（CDR；思维链未记录编辑且答案未翻转）在具有临床意义的破坏性编辑上全组平均为72.9%，思维链破坏不改变准确性，移除CoT提示也不降低准确性。两位董事会成员...
tldr: 本文通过医学扰动审计发现，大语言模型在医学问答中的思维链多为装饰性推理，对临床关键编辑不敏感，且移除思维链不影响准确性，揭示了其推理忠实性的严重缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals through medical perturbation audits that chain-of-thought in LLMs is largely decorative reasoning, insensitive to clinically critical edits, and removing it does not affect accuracy, exposing severe faithfulness deficiencies.
